title: FadoDB action definition
description: The definition of an action a rule may name (ADR-0045, item 1): its name, its parameters and what it returns. It holds no code and no secret. A definition as this schema describes it is the contract of a Go function the host program registers under the same name; the properties of an action the engine sends as an HTTP request (request, connection, ok, result) join the schema with the release that sends them.

name.description: A namespace and a verb joined by a dot, such as books.post. A name without a dot, and the namespaces table and http, are the engine's. Names match without regard to case.

version.description: The version of the definition, from 1. The database counts it: a redefinition is the next version, and a definition that gives a version gives that one.

description.description: What the action does, for the person or the agent who chooses it.

params.description: The parameters, by name. A rule gives each a formula of its type under args; a json parameter also takes a template, the JSON it becomes with a formula in the place of every string.

returns.description: The values the action returns, by name.

type.description: A scalar type (ADR-0013). int is decimal(0); decimal and money without a scale keep two places.

param.description: A parameter: its type alone, or its type with whether a call must give it and what it is for.

required.description: A call whose argument is blank is refused with required.

returned.description: A returned value: its type alone, or its type with what it is.
